skills.name: agentkit-audit
skills.description: Score an agentkit repo (prompt density, orchestration, context, security, site) into audit.json with APS. Use when auditing skill/agent prompts or refreshing the audit dashboard.

skills.name: context-budget
skills.description: Pause long Claude Code sessions at a token budget: write a checkpoint, ask for /compact or /clear, auto-reinject on resume. Use when the user wants session token monitoring, a context budget, or pause/resume on long runs.

skills.name: context-compressor
skills.description: Write short summarization checkpoints (goal, decisions+reasons, state, open threads, memory keys) to survive context pressure. Use when a session is long, before compaction or risky multi-step runs, at task boundaries, or before handoff.

skills.name: daily-standup
skills.description: Summarize commits, closed issues/PRs and open threads since the last standup into 3 lines (did/doing/blocked). Use when the user asks for a standup update, status report, or "what did I do yesterday".

skills.name: data-architect
skills.description: Decide data platform trade-offs (storage, compute, orchestration, batch vs streaming) and record an ADR. Use when choosing a warehouse/orchestrator, streaming vs batch, dbt vs Spark, designing a pipeline architecture, or "should I use X or Y".

skills.name: data-eng-router
skills.description: Detect the cloud/platform of a data engineering task (GCP, AWS, Azure, Databricks) and route to its ext-* skill. Use when asked for help with a data pipeline, ETL/ELT, warehouse, or data lake.

skills.name: data-quality-standards
skills.description: Apply schema, freshness, volume, idempotency and PII checks to a data pipeline before it ships. Use when writing tests for a dbt model/pipeline, reviewing a pipeline PR, or asked "what checks should this have".

skills.name: debug-loop
skills.description: Run a capped hypothesize-test-narrow loop on a failing test or reproducible bug to find root cause, not patch it. Use when the user has a failing test, stack trace, or reproducible crash.

skills.name: doc-standards
skills.description: Apply a consistent professional house style (palette, type, tables/charts, layout) to Word, Excel, PDF or PowerPoint files. Use when creating, formatting or polishing a docx/xlsx/pdf/pptx or when asked to "look professional".

skills.name: frontend-motion-3d
skills.description: Pick the lightest stack for UI animation and 3D (CSS/Motion, GSAP+ScrollTrigger, three.js/R3F, HyperFrames) within a perf and a11y budget. Use when asked for animations, scroll effects, 3D/WebGL, motion design, interactive heroes.

skills.name: genai-engineering
skills.description: Build and harden LLM apps: RAG, agents, evals, guardrails, cost/latency. Use when building or debugging a RAG system, LLM feature, agent or eval set, or when an LLM app is slow, costly or hallucinating.

skills.name: mcp-security-review
skills.description: Audit MCP server config for security risks: unpinned packages, secrets, broad filesystem access, unauthenticated remotes, shell wrappers. Use when adding an MCP server or reviewing .mcp.json or claude_desktop_config.json.

skills.name: meeting-to-actions
skills.description: Convert meeting notes or a transcript into action items with owners and dates. Use when the user pastes meeting notes, a transcript or call summary and wants action items extracted.

skills.name: memory
skills.description: Durable local SQLite memory: store and search episodes, facts and corrections. Use when the user says "remember this", when you need a past decision, preference or fix, or before debugging (check corrections first).

skills.name: memory-sync
skills.description: Mine recent session history for recurring agent mistakes, rank repeated patterns, and write durable corrections. Use when the user asks for a retro on recent sessions, recurring agent errors, or to make agents faster.

skills.name: ml-lifecycle
skills.description: Run an ML project from framing and leakage-safe splits through tracking, evaluation, registry, serving and drift monitoring. Use when training or evaluating a model, setting up MLflow/W&B, deploying a model, or when performance dropped.

skills.name: orchestrate
skills.description: Lead persona that plans a multi-part goal, fans independent tasks out to roster subagents, verifies, and synthesizes. Use when work spans several specialties, or user says "orchestrate", "fan out", "plan and delegate".

skills.name: pipeline-scaffold
skills.description: Scaffolds a dbt model, Airflow DAG, Dagster asset, or PySpark job with medallion naming and a test stub. Use when asked to create a new pipeline, model, DAG, asset, or Spark job boilerplate.

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Review a GitHub pull request for correctness bugs and scope creep, posting inline findings. Use when asked to review a PR, "look at PR #N", or check a branch before merge.

skills.name: prompt-enhancer
skills.description: Classifies a raw prompt's intent and rewrites it with that intent's pattern. Use when the user pastes a rough or underspecified prompt and asks to enhance, improve, tighten, or spec it up.

skills.name: setup-guardian
skills.description: Static health checks for this repo: dist/ freshness, install targets, skill counts, action SHA pins, CI gate, external lock, subprocess env=. Use when changing skills, install/build/workflows, or for a repo health check.

skills.name: skill-forge
skills.description: Scaffolds a compliant new skill (SKILL.md, reference/scripts/tests, golden test stub) from a one-line description. Use when asked to create, scaffold, or add a new skill to this repo.

skills.name: smart-navigator
skills.description: Structure-first repo recon: map manifests and a 2-level tree, then trace entry points instead of reading file by file. Use when in an unfamiliar codebase, finding where something lives or what calls it, or before scoping a change.

skills.name: spec-writer
skills.description: Turns a rough feature idea or bug report into a short spec: problem, scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria, tasks. Use when asked for a spec, design doc, or "write this up before we build it".

skills.name: token-saver
skills.description: Cuts input-token burn: search before read, line ranges, diff-first, batched calls, no re-reads, terse output. Use when a session burns context, reads feel wasteful, or a task spans many files/logs/shell output.

skills.name: ext-aws
skills.description: Route AWS tasks to pinned aws-samples/sample-agent-skills and zxkane/aws-skills. Use when the user wants AWS-specific help (Lambda, S3, IAM, CDK) from vendor or community skills.

skills.name: ext-azure
skills.description: Route Azure tasks to pinned microsoft/azure-skills and MicrosoftDocs/Agent-Skills. Use when the user wants Azure-specific help (App Service, Functions, AKS, Entra ID) from Microsoft-authored skills.

skills.name: ext-cli-ops
skills.description: Wire jfrog/boost shell-output compression into the running coding agent. Use when the user wants to save tokens on CLI/shell output, names jfrog Boost, or verbose commands are flooding context.

skills.name: ext-codegraph
skills.description: Bootstrap the pinned colbymchenry/codegraph CLI for symbol search, call paths and blast radius. Use when the user wants to understand or navigate a codebase and CodeGraph isn't installed.

skills.name: ext-databricks
skills.description: Route Databricks tasks to the pinned databricks/databricks-agent-skills collection. Use when the user wants Databricks-specific help (notebooks, jobs, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake) from vendor skills.

skills.name: ext-diagrams
skills.description: Route diagram requests to the pinned cathrynlavery/diagram-design skill. Use when the user wants an architecture diagram, flowchart, sequence or system diagram from the external diagram-design recipes.

skills.name: ext-gap-discovery
skills.description: Search the pinned VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills index for an existing skill. Use when the user wants a capability this repo lacks and asks what already exists before authoring a new skill.

skills.name: ext-gcp

skills.name: ext-meta-muse
skills.description: Wire Meta Muse image generation (generate, edit, iterate) into the agent via the pinned muse-image-mcp server. Use when the user asks for Meta Muse or AI-generated images/assets (hero art, textures, mockups).

skills.name: ext-systems-design
skills.description: Route system design questions to pinned anthropics/skills and awesome-system-design-resources. Use when making an architecture, scaling, DB/cache/queue, CAP or sharding decision and wanting deeper references.

skills.name: ext-ui-ux
skills.description: Route UI/UX design requests to the pinned nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill. Use when the user names the ui-ux-pro-max toolkit explicitly; otherwise prefer this repo's hallmark design work.
